name: ChocZero Sugar-Free Dark Chocolate (Soluble Fiber WARNING)
whyItWorks: Formulated with soluble corn fiber (dextrin) to achieve a zero-sugar claim, delivering 10g of isolated fiber per small bar. Soluble corn fiber undergoes rapid bacterial fermentation in the colon, producing heavy flatulence and lower abdominal distention.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active IBD. Standard dark chocolate with real sugar is far gentler on digestion than fiber-doped chocolate.
